svg.text: How the code is put together
A one-way data path. Components read through hooks and write through a promise API, so a real backend can replace src/api/ without touching a single screen.
Rule: components never import store.ts and never touch localStorage. Validation lives in the API method; the component catches the Error and shows it with ErrorNote or a toast.
Money is whole rupees. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings. Ids come from uid('prefix'). A payment that
cannot complete throws instead of part-paying, and money between two users writes a WalletTxn on
store.ts persistence · index.ts the API · hooks.ts reactive reads
shared pieces: FloorPlan, BedFitRoom, UnitCard, WalletCard …
primitives: PageHead, Button, StatusPill, Modal, Field
the 9-unit building, users, catalogue and pros
pure logic: format, rewards, planner, bedfit, photos, decoration
one folder per area; each page default-exports its screen
the domain model and the DB shape
Skipping the seed entry crashes users who already have a saved DB — load() spreads a fresh seed under it.
